lines: Due to the removal of the starting Paradox Path option in Update 33.6 (2023-07-27), these lines are no longer available.
- Lotus: "Wake up, Tenno. A choice awaits you."
- Lotus: "The path left is what I would expect of you. A warrior of frightening power. A Warframe at your command."
- Lotus: "But the path right, a paradox. Here you are, a prisoner of a twisted king. Seemingly powerless."
- Lotus: "Decide now. But know that in time, both paths converge. And you will hear his voice, that none have heard. Choose."
> Fast-paced, parkour-heavy combat against hordes of enemies.
> Void-marked Tenno and master the ways of the Warframe as you battle through 'Vor's Prize' and the Origin System.
> The 'Paradox Path' will open to you early in your progression.”
- Lotus: "For generations, you've slept. No purpose.... no call... to wake you."
- Lotus: "Grineer! Seeds from the ruins of the Old War. Swallowing colonies whole."
(Three statues of the three starter Warframes kneel in the center of a tower)
- Lotus: "The Tenno. Monuments of an ancient warrior caste. Scattered across frail worlds."
(Flashbacks between the girl offering purple Lotus flowers to the statues and the Warframes fighting first Grineer, then Dax soldiers)
- Lotus: "Together, they fought back. Bringing an end to an empire. Then, they left."
(Player chooses their starter Warframe: Excalibur, Volt, or Mag)
(Chosen warframe stumbles into center of room, falls to ground on one knee)
- Vor: "Hmm. I see the Lotus has tried to wake you... pity she's too late. You're my prize now, Tenno."
(Vor attaches Ascaris device to Warframe, walks away; soldiers aim weapons at player)
- Vor: "No! We are taking this one with us."
- Lotus: "What has he done to you? I can't lose another Tenno. I am surging your Warframe's power systems."
- Lotus: "Quick. Use your power. Defend yourself."
- Lotus: "An extraction ship is waiting for you. But the Grineer will be hunting you, arm yourself."
- Lotus: "A Tenno's melee weapon honors their warrior tradition. When technology was turned against them, they adapted."
- Lotus: "There's a cache of weapons ahead. Grab what you can."
- Lotus: "Tenno, pick up a weapon. You are running out of time."
- Grineer Lancer: "Klouvor hu rearr." - "Thought I heard."
- Lotus: "Good. The extraction point is up ahead. Hurry, before Vor finds out you've escaped."
- Lotus: "A Tenno flows like fire over the battle terrain. Do you remember how to dash up walls?"
- Vor: "Salvage team, why have you not reported in?"
- Lotus: "You made it. There's the extraction ship!"
(Player must destroy Vor's shields, possible maximum time)
- Vor: "My decrepit heart is pounding! This one is stronger than the rest. Lock the area down! This Tenno is mine!" [triggers area lockdown]
- Lotus: "Get out of there Tenno! You'll have to face Vor another time, when you are fully restored."
- Vor: "Grineer, my sons. Prepare the reinforcements, we need that Tenno."
- Vor: "The Queens want to destroy you, but I need to know more."
- Lotus: "Quick, get to the console and release the lockdown. Do that and I will guide you to your old ship. It's your only chance."
- Lotus: "Tenno, you need to go to the console to release the lockdown."
- Lotus: "I've marked the console on your map. You need to access it to release the lockdown."
- Lotus: "Escape will only be possible with a primary weapon. Choose now."
- Lotus: "I'm not sure what Vor has done to your Warframe, but we cannot remove it now. Just keep going, your ship is up ahead."
- Lotus: "There it is, your ship. Hurry, Vor's reinforcements must be on their way."
- Lotus: "There's the ship. It will require power. Activate it."

path: At Landing Pad with the Liset Ship
lines: - Lotus: "Your Parazon is a versatile tool, use it to breach this panel and restart the ship."
- Ordis: (upon hacking the panel) "Stop touching me, you— what? Are my sensors deceiving me? Operator, is that you?"
- Lotus: "Enemy reinforcements are here! Ship Cephalon, we require immediate extraction."
- Ordis: "The Operator is in danger? I will need a few moments to cycle the engines!"
- Vor: "Tenno, are you afraid? You cannot hide from these old eyes. I've marked you. You will return to me."
- Lotus: "Tenno, the ship is ready. It's time to leave."
